descriptor.operator: Government of Zambia National Spatial Data Infrastructure / ZILMIS
descriptor.scope: 31 valid distinct public cadastral-reference polygons verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete bounded manifest paging, forced three-row pages, all 31 fresh source-ID reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 54 requests. Independent metric EPSG:32735 GEOS found all geometries valid and distinct, with no sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Source-native SDE.Lots.OBJECTID is the unique GIS reference identity; the original UPID label is retained unchanged. The first UPID identity qualification is preserved as failed: one blank UPID matched 38,736 records and cannot serve as a unique native parcel key. A fresh run using source OIDs preserves all sampled geometry and passes every query check. Provider offset pagination is unsupported; complete count-checked object-ID manifests and bounded object-ID batches are used instead. Native source CRS is EPSG:32735. The exact WUP point returned no lot; all three original nearby UPID-labelled samples match fresh full source geometry exactly. Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy, currentness and long-term GIS key continuity remain unverified. Additional enabled city entries have separate bounded qualification evidence; wider coverage remains unverified.

evidence: Official CadasterNew item metadata describes the service as Zambia national cadaster data and customary lots (saved in prior bounded evidence at tmp/qualification-valhalla/q1012catchup/state/cities/2260/attempt-03/evidence/official-purpose-metadata.json).

Official MapServer layer 0 metadata identifies the Lots polygon layer and SDE.Lots.OBJECTID as its OID; official service metadata declares spatialReference WKID 32735 (saved files: official-layer-metadata.json and official-service-metadata.json in the prior Chirundu evidence directory).

The current catalog descriptor zm-nsdi-zilmis-lots points to this same first-party MapServer layer and declares SDE.Lots.OBJECTID as the integer source identity with EPSG:32735 metric and bounds CRS. Four nearby native IDs from the prior Chirundu bounded sample are reused only as read targets; this new run re-reads all IDs and geometry.
